posts.body_html: You're welcome Nico!  After growing out many different clones, it seems under optimal conditions, most of the S. flava var. rugelii's can produce a red throat.  However, certain clones, like Clone A, AxB, clone B, clone D, etc. consistently produce a well defined red throat year after year.
